mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_conversation (conversation_id, user_id, title, status) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, title, status, active_task_id, generation, version FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, title, status, active_task_id, generation, version FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}

SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, title, status, active_task_id, generation, version FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (#{cursorId} IS NULL OR id < #{cursorId}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_conversation SET active_task_id = #{taskId}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_task_id IS NULL

UPDATE sq_conversation SET status = 'DELETED', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'DELETING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution r WHERE r.user_id=sq_conversation.user_id AND r.conversation_id=sq_conversation.conversation_id AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, title, status, active_task_id, generation, version FROM sq_conversation WHERE status = 'DELETING' AND active_task_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution r WHERE r.user_id=sq_conversation.user_id AND r.conversation_id=sq_conversation.conversation_id AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
